# GitHub users whose fork PRs get rbe-west's trusted OSS pool. One numeric
# user id per line, the login as a comment; blank lines and # comments are
# ignored. Ids, not logins: a renamed account's old login can be registered
# by anyone. Look an id up with: gh api users/<login> --jq .id
#
# rbe-west's rbe-fork-mint reads this file from the default branch, never
# from a PR: editing it in a PR changes nothing until it merges. A listed
# author's own-fork PR, triggered by a listed user, gets rbe-fork tier rw
# (bazel.yml mode fork-rw: the trusted OSS pool, results cached by its
# workers) when the farm has rw switched on; everyone else gets tier ro
# (the fork pool). A line that is not a numeric id makes the mint treat the
# list as empty. Same people as gascity's .github/blacksmith-allowlist.txt.
# The path is the mint's configuration (MINT_REPOS): keep it although
# bazel-farm.yml, which first read this list, is gone.
8082291 # julianknutsen
91582 # quad341
36544495 # sjarmak
2568253 # csells
